jobs.description:
For an international company active in the medical sector, we are looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist to support the development and execution of digital marketing activities across the Benelux region.The company develops and distributes high-quality medical products and solutions to healthcare professionals worldwide. With a strong international presence, the organization combines innovation, quality and customer focus with a commitment to employee development and collaboration.

Jobomschrijving

The roleAs a Digital Marketing Specialist, you will be responsible for implementing digital marketing campaigns and supporting local marketing initiatives across the Benelux. You will work closely with the Marketing Manager to translate the marketing strategy into impactful campaigns that increase brand awareness, engage healthcare professionals and support commercial objectives.Your responsibilities:

• Digital campaigns & content: Develop and coordinate digital campaigns across social media, newsletters, websites and external platforms, ensuring engaging and relevant content for the target audience.
• Local marketing activation: Adapt international marketing initiatives to local market needs and support the communication of promotions, events and webinars.
• Website & webshop management: Ensure that online content, product information and promotional activities are accurate and up to date.
• Performance analysis: Monitor campaign performance through relevant KPIs, report on results and identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness.
• Operational marketing & project coordination: Support the development of promotional materials, budget tracking and supplier coordination, ensuring projects are delivered efficiently and on time.

Your profile

• You have initial a first experience in digital marketing or a similar marketing role.
• You are fluent in French and English. A basic knowledge of Dutch is an asset.
• You have experience with digital campaigns and content creation. Knowledge of tools such as Canva, HubSpot or Hootsuite is a plus.
• Experience managing websites or webshops is an advantage.
• You are organized, proactive and hands-on, with the ability to manage projects independently and handle multiple priorities.
• You have strong communication skills, an analytical mindset and a willingness to learn.

jobs.occupation: Regulatory Affairs Specialist - Medical Devices - EN
jobs.description:
International healthcare organization active in the medical device sector, supporting patient care through innovative products distributed across multiple global markets.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Regulatory Affairs Specialist - Medical Devices - EN, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Coordinate product registrations across assigned international markets
• Prepare and submit regulatory documentation with internal and external stakeholders
• Support ongoing compliance activities for medical device portfolios
• Manage regulatory aspects of product changes throughout the lifecycle
• Review and assess regulatory implications of marketing materials
• Monitor regulatory developments and communicate relevant updates
• Act as a key contact for manufacturers, distributors, and authorities
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within Regulatory Affairs

As a successful Regulatory Affairs Specialist - Medical Devices - EN, you will have the following profile:

• Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacy, Regulatory Affairs or related field
• 1-3 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs within medical devices
• Strong knowledge of MDR requirements and registration processes
• Experience supporting product registrations and lifecycle activities
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
• Proactive personality who actively seeks information and drives actions forward
• Comfortable collaborating with international stakeholders
• Fluent in English
• Strong analytical and organizational skills
• Team-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset

Our client is a well-established organization operating in a dynamic and professional environment, offering a central role with direct exposure to senior management and strategic decision-making.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the CEO's calendar, meetings, and appointments.
• Coordinate recurring management, board, and shareholder meetings.
• Handle incoming and outgoing communications, including urgent matters.
• Maintain and update key contacts and administrative records.
• Prepare meeting materials and coordinate attendees.
• Support telephone reception and general administrative tasks.
• Assist with marketing activities, including client events, website management, and LinkedIn communications.
• Coordinate facility-related projects and external service providers across offices.

• Experience as an Executive Assistant, Management Assistant, or Office Manager.
• Fluent in Dutch and French, with a good level of English.
• Proactive, autonomous, and highly organized.

Our client is a well-established international industrial manufacturing company with production facilities in Belgium and abroad. The company is recognised for its strong market position and continuous focus on innovation, customer service and operational excellence.

Jobomschrijving

As Supply Chain Manager you will:

• Lead a Supply Chain organisation of 90 fte (of which 6 direct reports) covering demand planning, customer service and transportation planning.
• Develop and enhance forecasting and demand planning processes to improve service levels, forecast accuracy and business performance.
• Define, implement and monitor relevant Supply Chain KPI's and SLA frameworks to support scalable growth.
• Drive customer segmentation initiatives and align differentiated service levels with planning and supply strategies.
• Support the introduction of new product ranges while contributing to product portfolio rationalisation initiatives.

A successful Supply Chain Manager should have:

• Practical capability in coordinating supply chain activities.
• Experience with planning material and product flows.
• Ability to monitor supply chain information and act on operational priorities.
• Knowledge of procurement and supply chain processes.
• Ability to maintain accurate data for planning and follow-up.
• Confidence working with internal stakeholders on supply chain coordination.
• Collaborate closely with stakeholders including Commercial, Product Marketing, Operations and ICT teams to ensure end-to-end supply chain alignment.
• Lead, coach and develop a team of 6 direct reports and approximately 90 indirect reports.
• A good professional level of Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: EMEA Sales Manager - Specialty Polymers & Elastomer Materials
jobs.description:
The role focuses on managing and developing relationships with large international customers across the industrial materials sector.

Jobomschrijving

As a Sales Manager your responsibilities are:

• Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve business objectives.
• Manage and grow key accounts, ensuring long-term relationships with clients.
• Identify market opportunities and devise plans to capitalise on them.
• Monitor sales performance and analyse data to improve results.
• Collaborate with internal teams to align sales strategies with company goals.
• Lead and motivate the sales team to achieve individual and collective targets.
• Prepare and present regular sales reports to senior management.
• Stay updated on retail market trends and competitor activities.

A successful Sales Manager should have:

• 10  years of experience in sales and business development.
• Proven success managing international and global key accounts.
• Strong background in specialty materials, raw materials, polymers, plastics, compounding, or related industrial sectors.
• Experience within the TPE/TPC/SBC market is highly desirable.
• Demonstrated ability to develop business and grow strategic customer relationships.
• Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and ability to close complex deals.
• Fluent English (written and verbal).
• Comfortable working within a multicultural and international environment.
• Highly autonomous, self-motivated, and capable of working independently.

jobs.occupation: Operations Coordinator - Dutch & German speaking m/f/d (Callcenteragent/in)
jobs.description: **Location:**  GhentClient confidentialTransport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. This is us, your new colleaguesYou will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.This is the job- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business Are you the one?- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.- Well-being services- Restaurant on site- Opportunity to grow within the company- Good work life balance- International environment- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

Job description 

    
• No experience in car transport required (CE licence experience is essential)
    
• Working week: Mon–Fri (full-time; longer hours possible but not compulsory)
    
• You may take the lorry home – can leave from your place of residence
    
• Language: German or English (minimum)
    
• Candidates may live in Belgium (German payroll)

 Requirements 

National routes, with occasional trips across the border to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, or France.

No experience is required; we are looking for passion and motivation for vehicle transport.

A CE driving licence, Code 95 qualification, and a valid medical fitness certificate are required.

Job description 
 What will you do? 
    
• 
        
Play the early bird: The road is yours while the rest of the world is still hitting snooze.

    
    
• 
        
Embrace variety: Shuttle between regional clients carrying agricultural products, sand, gravel, or waste (no ADR stress!).

    
    
• 
        
Be versatile: Switch smoothly between a tipper and a curtain-sider like it's nothing.

    
    
• 
        
Build some muscle: A physical challenge doesn't scare you off.

    

 Requirements 
 Who are you? 
    
• 
        
You hold a CE License + Code 95 (crucial, otherwise things get awkward with the police).

    
    
• 
        
You speak Dutch, French, or English (as long as we can understand each other by the coffee machine).

    
    
• 
        
You are flexible, precise, and treat your truck as if it were your own.

    
    
• 
        
Want extra hours? Great! More hours = more cash.

Job description 

You will be responsible for delivering meat to companies, distribution centers, or supermarkets with a refrigerated trailer.

Possibility of driving shuttles between the customer and distribution centers.

Loading at the processor and 2 to 3 stops per day. Unloading at the dock or using the loading bridge and electric pallet truck.

Working from Monday to Friday.

Ready to hit the road? Apply today and join our team of drivers!

 

 Requirements 

    
• CE driver's license with a valid C95.
    
• You have initial experience in refrigerated transport.
    
• You are Dutch or speak English well.
    
• Shifts from 10 to 13 hours per day.
    
• Good, open communication with planning/management.

Job description 

Looking for freedom and your own dedicated truck (after your onboarding period)? This is your route:

    
• 
        
What: National transport (tipper and curtain-sider) of steel and miscellaneous materials.

    
    
• 
        
When: Early mornings (start between 4 AM and 6 AM) for a full 10-12 hour day.

    
    
• 
        
How: Independently, punctually, and in close contact with dispatch.

    

 Requirements 

    
• 
        
Valid CE license + Code 95.

    
    
• 
        
Speaks Dutch, French, or English.

    
    
• 
        
An early bird who loves working independently and accurately.

    
    
• 
        
An honest team player who cares for the equipment and the customer.

Job description 

Are you someone who enjoys getting on the road and loves long drives? Do you have a CE driving license and are you looking for a job where you can rack up the miles? Then definitely read on!

What will you do?

You will deliver new, empty oil drums with a mega trailer. You leave every day from Lier and primarily drive in Belgium and the Netherlands. You start between 4 AM and 7 AM and make between 3 to 8 stops a day. Sometimes you unload the drums yourself (for a nice extra fee). Occasionally, there is work on Saturdays, but that's at 150% pay.

What do we expect?

You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English. You possess a CE driving license with the necessary documents. You have some experience driving a mega trailer. Physical work is not a problem for you, and you do it with a smile.You may be required to operate different types of trailers and transport various kinds of goods. Therefore, it is important that you are flexible and open to a variety of tasks.

What do you get?

A well-filled odometer - lots of miles to cover. A stable job at a company that values you. Attractive and fair compensation, including extras for physical tasks and weekend work. Job security and a fixed departure and arrival location in Lier.

Are you eager to hit the road? Let us know and respond today!

 Requirements 

    
• You possess a CE driving license and all necessary documents (Code 95, driver card).
    
• You have experience driving a mega trailer.
    
• You speak and understand Dutch or English well.
    
• You enjoy working with different types of trailers and various goods. No day is the same!
    
• Physically demanding work does not deter you, and you carry out your tasks with a smile.
    
• You have your own transportation to get to the site.

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver with On-Board Forklift (Moffett)
jobs.description:
Job description 

Welcome to the wonderful world of truck drivers! You will hit the road with an impressive tractor-trailer combination. Waking up early is essential, as you will be leaving between 5 and 7 in the morning. Don't worry, you are allowed to work around 12 hours a day, which is more than enough time to make the asphalt disappear under your fantastic vehicle. Of course, you are a true adventurer, so crossing a border occasionally doesn't faze you. Fortunately, most of it is national work, so you won't need an international driving license.

You will make between 4 to 6 stops a day, which means you will spend a lot of time on the road. Naturally, as a superhero driver with a CE license, you will be responsible for loading, transporting, and delivering various goods. Do you have experience with a fork truck (kooiaap)? Then you have an advantage. But don't panic if that's not the case, because you can still receive training for it internally. And if you're a true night owl, you can also take night trips for this position. The choice is yours! Just let us know.

 Requirements 

    
• Driver's license: CE + code 95.
    
• Knowledge of Dutch, French, or English.

Do you want to wrap up our team?
 

Tropack is a family business, active as an industrial supplier and service provider. Our core business? Storing and packing goods, parts and spare parts for the non-food sector. This with a big smile, for more than 30 years.
 

As a close team, we offer new employees a warm second home. Short lines of communication and a human approach are key for us.
 

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an quality Inspector Exchange.
 

Location: Oostakker
 

What will be your responsibilities as an inspector?
 
 

• You check and sort used goods. 

• You find out which part it is: type of part, serial number, etc. 

• You perform a visual quality check based on instructions provided. 

• You record the necessary data per part in the computer system. 

• You store the parts in the predefined location after making the right decision. 

• You move goods using a stacker. 

• You report to your team leader. 
 

• You are a motivated employee who likes to roll up your sleeves and don’t mind getting dirty. 

• You enjoy working independently and know how to make proactive adjustments where necessary.  

• Working with a computer? No problem! 

• You can work at a fast pace and attaches great importance to delivering quality.  

• You are available to work full-time in shifts. One week, you will work from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, and the following week from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM. 

• Fluent in English or Dutch.

Job description 

Our client in the Kortrijk/Menen region is looking for CE drivers for transporting sea containers. Usually for picking up and dropping off, but sometimes also just unloading at the quay. Nice working days of approximately 12 hours and home every day.

Loading and unloading locations at terminals in the ports of Ghent/Antwerp and at the client's warehouses and companies.

 Requirements 

You are motivated to work in the ports. You have a valid CE driving license with C95.

You have a good knowledge of Dutch, English, or French.

You live in the Kortrijk/Westhoek region.

Job description 

You will be responsible for delivering meat to companies, distribution centers, or supermarkets with a refrigerated trailer.

Possibility of driving shuttles between the customer and distribution centers.

Loading at the processor and 2 to 3 stops per day. Unloading at the dock or using the loading bridge and electric pallet truck.

Working from Monday to Friday.

 

 Requirements 

    
• CE driver's license with a valid C95.
    
• You have initial experience in refrigerated transport.
    
• You are Dutch or speak English well.
    
• Shifts from 10 to 13 hours per day.
    
• Good, open communication with planning/management.

jobs.occupation: Night CE truck driver for live poultry transport
jobs.description:
Job description 
 What Does Your Night Look Like?

    
• While most people are asleep, you're on the road as a vital link in our transport operation.
    
• You collect chickens from poultry farms and transport them safely to their destination.
    
• Enjoy quiet roads and traffic-free driving from Sunday evening through to Friday morning.
    
• Using a forklift (kooiaap), you load and unload containers safely and efficiently.
    
• You complete 1 to 3 transport runs per night, visiting different locations along the way.
    
• At the end of your shift, you ensure your truck is clean and ready for the next working day.

A role that offers plenty of independence, responsibility and the freedom of night driving. Perfect for drivers who enjoy quiet roads and staying ahead of the traffic.

 Requirements 
 Do You Have the Right Drive?

    
• You are a responsible driver with a professional attitude.
    
• You are comfortable working in an environment where industry-related odours are part of the job.
    
• Experience operating a truck-mounted forklift (kooiaap) is a strong advantage.
    
• You can communicate effectively in Dutch, English, or French.

Job description 
 As a CE truck driver, you will be responsible for delivering various types of materials throughout Belgium. Whether it’s express deliveries, pallet transport, or construction-related materials, you’ll encounter a wide variety of jobs. Every day is different, while still offering a familiar routine. What does your day look like? 
    
• You start your day between 5:00 and 8:00 a.m. at our site in Bornem with a cup of coffee and a vehicle check.
    
• You will deliver various goods throughout Belgium. Occasionally, you may cross the border, but you will always return home at the end of the day.
    
• The number of daily stops depends on the schedule. Sometimes you may have just 1 stop, while on other days you could have up to 10.
 What are we looking for? 
    
• You have a CE driving licence and the required certificates.
    
• You have a valid ADR certificate.
    
• You are flexible, reliable, and customer-friendly.
    
• You are physically fit.
    
• You have experience as a CE truck driver.
    
• You have good knowledge of the road network.
    
• You have a good command of Dutch or English due to safety requirements.
 What can you expect from us? 
    
• A competitive salary.
    
• A great working atmosphere and the opportunity to drive modern, high-quality equipment.

Can you tick all the boxes above? Apply today and join our team!

 Requirements 

    
• You have a Category C driving licence and the required certificates.
    
• You have a valid ADR certificate.
    
• You are flexible, reliable, and customer-friendly.
    
• You are physically fit.
    
• You have experience as a Category C truck driver.
    
• You have good knowledge of the road network.
    
• You have a good command of Dutch or English due to safety requirements.
